name: Mantener la app despierta

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 */6 * * *"     # cada 6 horas (a y 17 de la hora)
  workflow_dispatch:            # y a mano, desde la pestaña Actions

jobs:
  visitar:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install playwright && playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Abrir la app
        run: |
          python - <<'EOF'
          import re
          from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
          with sync_playwright() as p:
              pagina = p.chromium.launch().new_page()
              pagina.goto("https://calisten-ia.streamlit.app", timeout=120_000)
              boton = pagina.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("get this app back up"))
              try:
                  boton.click(timeout=20_000)
                  print("Estaba dormida: la despierto")
              except Exception:
                  print("Ya estaba despierta")
              pagina.wait_for_timeout(90_000)   # se queda 90 s para que cuente como visita
          EOF
